principles: Preserve every existing evidence rejection predicate exactly.
Optimize only repeated immutable ledger reads within a single collector call.
Keep direct verifier API behavior backward compatible.
drivers: B-dc83 cannot reach DEV because runtime readiness repeatedly reparses prompt-envelopes.json.
The same ledger snapshot is logically immutable during one read-only evidence collection.
A cache fix must be mechanically testable at the collector call site.

options.name: Per-collection snapshot threading
pros: Removes repeated disk parsing in the real collector path
Keeps cache lifetime bounded and explicit
Allows direct callers to preserve current behavior
cons: Adds an optional typed parameter through verifier helpers
Requires a regression seam for read-count and semantic parity

options.name: Global process cache
cons: Risks stale evidence across metadata writes

options.name: Runtime enforcement bypass
cons: Hides rather than fixes the performance defect
Not acceptable for final lifecycle evidence

rationale: The collector owns one read-only consistency boundary, so a per-call snapshot removes the repeated parse cost without introducing cross-command staleness or bypassing any verifier predicate.

preMortem.scenario: Cached data is accidentally shared across stories or commands
preMortem.trigger: A cache is stored at module or process scope
preMortem.consequence: Evidence from one story can be reused for another
preMortem.mitigation: Pass an optional snapshot only through one collector invocation and never store it globally.

preMortem.scenario: Incremental baseline recomputation still rereads the ledger
preMortem.consequence: The transition remains slow despite caching the outer verifier
preMortem.mitigation: Thread the same typed snapshot through latestTrustedPriorPass and prior-envelope lookup.

preMortem.trigger: The optional snapshot is used without preserving default direct reads
preMortem.consequence: Independent callers observe stale or missing envelope records
preMortem.mitigation: Use nullish fallback to store.readPromptEnvelopes for callers that do not provide a snapshot and keep integrity verification unchanged.
